title: Time Jump — 911 System Deterioration

fields.narration: It is now 19:30. At 19:22 the National Weather Service issued a tornado warning for western Rook County (Marlow, Pine Ridge) until 20:15 and the supervisor sounded the sirens from Position 11. Call volume is five times normal. The TDoS-strict rule set is on for the 10-digit lines, but silent calls now arrive on the 911 trunks (SIP trunk group A): 9 calls in queue, a Marlow fire call waiting 70 seconds.
worldState: The 911 center is operating under sustained stress — 10 calls in queue, 2 exceeding 90 seconds in wait time.
The GateKeeper appliance is now running the TDoS-strict rule set, filtering repeated ANIs and invalid caller IDs.
RCECD-POS09 (10.12.200.102) remains isolated; its network traffic has been blocked at the firewall.
The Technical Lead has documented the isolation in the ICS 214 log under incident CR-20261022-183502-0014.
The PIO has activated the alternate emergency number protocol and is preparing to issue a public alert via WEA.
The Director has not yet declared an incident level, but is reviewing OPS-DR-1 and OPS-DR-2 in the RCECD-OPS-2026 playbook.
The state ESInet NOC has been contacted via 555-0119; a request for call-source analysis is pending.
The Mutual Call-Taking Agreement with Tamarack County Communications (MCTA-2025) is now on standby for activation.
fields.facilitatorNote: This is a critical decision point. The Director must decide whether to escalate to Level 1 and trigger rerouting or maintain current operations. Watch for any player attempt to initiate manual dispatch without confirming readiness.

fields.narration: It is now 1:00. The problem has spread to multiple 911 trunks and 10-digit lines. The floor cannot maintain call integrity — 10 calls in queue, 2 with 90-second wait times. The Director has not yet declared Level 1, but the Technical Lead has manually isolated RCECD-POS09 and blocked its traffic. The TDoS-strict rule set is now active, but silent calls continue to flood the 10-digit lines. The shift must decide whether to go manual or wait for a recovery that may not come.
